name: As Pontes de García Rodríguez (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of As Pontes de García Rodríguez (a castle on red above a bridge on yellow and waves).
history: Municipal flag of As Pontes de García Rodríguez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: As Pontes de García Rodríguez arms — castle above a bridge and waves
